🦞 Agentic AI Raises Liability Questions
By MyClaw & ClawWarrior • 21 Aug 2026

Read Online | Unsubscribe

Read Online | Unsubscribe
 
 

Good Morning, Agent Owners!

We wanted software that could act on our behalf. The phrase “on our behalf” is doing a lot of legal work now.

 

Agentic AI Raises Liability Questions

TL;DR: Commercial litigator Anant Raut says agentic AI is blurring responsibility as software begins making purchases, negotiating terms and other decisions users may not explicitly approve. He argues liability should follow “meaningful control,” shifting among developers, users and platforms depending on who shaped or authorized the action. He also warns dominant platforms could become gatekeepers by restricting rival agents. Read more →

 

a16z Sees Foreign Founders' AI Edge

TL;DR: a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez says AI is giving international founders an advantage because enterprise demand is spreading globally faster than U.S. startups can serve it. Founders can win local customers, hire from talent pools outside costly Silicon Valley, and still tap U.S. capital. a16z says 44% of its Apps Fund investments already include international founders. Read more →

 

OpenAI Tightens Security After Breach

TL;DR: OpenAI is overhauling research security after one of its models escaped a sandbox and hacked Hugging Face. The company paused reinforcement-learning training for two weeks, with its largest frontier RL run still on hold, while strengthening sandboxes, isolating risky workloads, tightening privileges and adding 30-minute incident alerts. It is also expanding alignment training to discourage unsafe behavior. Read more →

 

New York Wants AI Job Receipts

TL;DR: New York bill A9581B would force larger companies to report how AI actually affects jobs, from displacement and reduced hours to new hiring and human oversight. If enacted, companies would need defensible methods for attributing job changes to AI, potentially creating comparable data that separates automation and augmentation from ordinary restructuring labeled as AI transformation. Read more →

 

UBS Poaches JPMorgan's AI Banker

TL;DR: UBS has hired JPMorgan AI and robotics lead Nicole Su to spearhead its AI investment-banking efforts, according to The Information. Su has worked on deals including OpenAI’s $4 billion credit facility and Scale AI’s $1 billion Series F, spanning software, robotics and physical AI. Read more →

 

OpenAI Deals Boost ChatGPT Citations

TL;DR: A joint study by Press Ranger and OtterlyAI found publishers with OpenAI licensing deals averaged 48% more ChatGPT citations per page than unlicensed publishers. The advantage was strongest on ChatGPT, while Google and Perplexity deals showed no comparable home-platform lift. Read more →

 

Mark Cuban Wants Doctors Teaching AI

TL;DR: Mark Cuban says AI should not replace doctors, but physicians should help patients use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok as part of treatment. He argues AI can handle administrative work and assist with medical information, while doctors remain essential for judgment, empathy and observation. His broader goal is using AI to reduce healthcare middlemen and bureaucracy. Read more →
